description: This file defines the TwigTest class, which represents a template test in the Twig templating engine. It includes methods for constructing test instances, retrieving the test type, and checking requirements related to charset, environment, and context.

classes.name: TwigTwigTest
classes.description: Represents a test in the Twig templating system, with configurable options and specific requirements for arguments and context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new TwigTest instance with the given name, callable, and options.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'test', indicating the type of this object.

methods.name: needsCharset
methods.description: Indicates that this test does not need charset information.

methods.name: needsEnvironment
methods.description: Indicates that this test does not need environment information.

methods.name: needsContext
methods.description: Indicates that this test does not need context information.

methods.name: hasOneMandatoryArgument
methods.description: Checks if the test requires one mandatory argument based on options.

methods.name: getMinimalNumberOfRequiredArguments
methods.description: Returns the minimal number of arguments required by the test, including parent class requirements.
